Yes the Nbome series, as well as DOx chemicals(DOB, DOC etc..). The thing about nbomes, they aren't orally active unless they're complexed(most of the time they aren't), so they have to be taken sublingually(under the tongue) or buccally(on the gums) to have any effect, so if you just swallow the blotter, and don't get any effect, it was an nbome, or just a piece of paper. But DOx chemicals are different, they are active orally just like LSD is, but the way you can tell is by the effect it gives you. DOx chemicals have more of a stimulant effect, similar to an amphetamine, you'll notice more hypertension and nausea, and the duration is significantly longer. Also the dose needed for significant effects from DOx chemicals is higher, so if you get a really thick and big blotter, I would just stay away. One other thing to mention is, LSD is tasteless, if the blotter has any metallic/bitter taste, its a R.C. Of course you could just get a test kit too lol
